injuries.description: The deceased sustained a crush and cut injury to his right hand amputating his right little finger at the proximal interphalangeal joint.
source: The deceased sustained a crush and cut injury to his right hand amputating his right little finger at the proximal interphalangeal joint.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation of other single finger

injuries.description: The damage to the index and middle finger was repaired by internal fixation by pins

injuries.description: he was left with ankylosing (a consolidation and immobilising of the bones) of the proximal and distal interphalangeal joints of the right ring and middle fingers, and the distal interphalangeal joint of the index finger.
